out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers (bottle water) is stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils (on prep counter near cookline in main kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage No Contamination
violations.observation: Food (pallet of hamburger buns) stored in a location (directly in front of the hand sink in back main kitchen) where it is subject to splash.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food where it is not exposed to splash, dust or other contamination. CDI: CFM relocated the pallet of hamburger buns away from the hand sink.

out_items.name: Personal cleanliness

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Employees observed wearing jewelry (bracelet) on their arms and hands while preparing food at the flatgrill.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing. CDI: CFM instructed food employee to remove bracelet and wash hands before returning to preparing food.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equipment/Utensils Air Drying
violations.observation: Metal pans were found stacked while wet after cleaning and chemical sanitization on shelf next to ice machine in the main kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: After cleaning and sanitizing, equipment and utensils shall be air-dried or used after adequate draining before contact with food. EHS instructed CFM to separate the metal pans and allow to fully dry before stacking.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Observed soda bottle containing content stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. CDI: EHS instructed CFM to transfer drinks to plastic cup with lid and straw and stored away from the cookline/ prep areas.

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Observed food employee drinking from soda bottle on the cookline where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. CDI: EHS instructed CFM to transfer drinks to plastic cup with lid and straw.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: Observed a food employee failed to wash his hands when entering kitchen and before engaging in food preparation.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. CDI: EHS instructed CFM to wash hands when entering kitchen and engaging in food preparation. BIG BUNS (Inspection Date: 04/01/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the front bar area is blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing. Observed paper towels holder stored in hand sink basin.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. CDI: CFM removed paper towels holder from the hand sink basin.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: raw shelled eggs stored above ground beef hamburger patties inside the walk in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). CDI: CFM relocated raw shelled eggs to the shelf above ground beef hamburger patties inside the walk in refrigerator.

violations.title: Gloves, Use Limitation (Single-Use Gloves)
violations.observation: Single use gloves observed improperly used in the following manner: food employee used gloved hand to grab raw hamburger patty and placed on flatgrill, seasoned the hamburger patties, and continued other tasks without changing gloves and washing hands in between.
violations.corrective_action: If used, single-use gloves shall be used for only ONE task and used for no other purposes. The single-use gloves shall be discarded when damaged or soiled or when interruptions occur in the operation. CDI: EHS instructed food employee to change gloves and wash hands when changing to a different food prep task.

out_items.name: Proper cooling time and temperature

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours: cooked quinoa (47F) and cooked barley (44F) cooling overnight.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. CDI: CFM discarded cooked quinoa and cooked barley.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed fresh kale 44F inside Atosa 2 Dr preptop refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: CFM discarded fresh kale.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that chemicals are improperly stored properly stored to prevent the contamination of stored clean food equipment (slicer) on bottom shelf next to the walk in refrigerator in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. CDI: CFM relocated chemicals away from clean slicer to chemical storage area across from the mop sink.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed bag of onions stored on the floor next to walk in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CDI: CFM relocated bag of onions to shelf in the kitchen area.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils Self-Draining Position/Covered/Inverted
violations.observation: Observed ice bin that has been cleaned not stored covered or inverted on top of the ice machine in the kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: Clean equipment and utensils shall be stored covered or inverted to prevent contamination. CDI: EHS instructed CFM to wash, rinse, and sanitize the ice bin and stored inverted on clean contact surface.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: uncooked hamburger patties stored directly above uncooked red snapper filet inside 4 drawer undergrill refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. CDI: CFM relocated hamburger patties to bottom shelf of the 4 drawer undergrill refrigerator.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed box of vanilla ice cream/ shake mix stored directly on the floor inside the walk in freezer and less than 6 inches off the floor.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CDI: CFM relocated box of vanilla ice cream/ shake mix to shelf inside the walk in freezer.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: EHS observed a posted employee health policy in the office of the facility. EHS did not observe reviewed agreed and signed copies of the employee health policy in the facility during the time of inspection
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EHS provided blank copies of employee health policy to PIC, Pic had employees review agree and sign the policies.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: EHS observed no written procedures for vomit and diarrhea cleanup.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS provided copy of vomit and diarrhea clean up to PIC

violations.observation: EHs observed Chicken x4 (55, 49, 48, 49) being held above 41F for longer than 4 hours using a calibrated thermometer in a 4 drawer under flat top cooler
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC disposed of chicken being held above 41F for longer than 4 hours

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Warewashing Machine Operated per Data Plate
violations.observation: EHS observed mechanical ware washing machine not being operated per the dat plate. Data stated there was required 50ppm of CL for wash rinse and sanitize cycle. EHS observed CL at 0ppm
violations.corrective_action: A warewashing machine and its auxiliary components shall be operated in accordance with the machine's data plate and other manufacturer's instructions. PIC replaced container of CL and ran dishwasher, EHS observed dishwasher at 50ppm minimum

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The hot water at sink basin in the front serving station is below 100F i.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. Adjust the hot water temperature a this location, to at least 100F.
